notes: The italic *the grain* is `added`: the Hebrew writes no object for the infinitive, and rule 44's supplied-object sentence keeps such a word out of the verb's unit. The ASV italic corroborates without deciding it (rule 7).
The suffix on the infinitive construct takes the subject pronoun *he* (rule 18), and the בְּ takes the *when* of the finite recasting (rule 52).
